listing.name: Devil May Cry — dmc-recomp (Gui-Tora)
listing.summary: Research project. Source-only prereleases; explicitly not playable; late-stream MPEG/rendering blockers. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL Europe SLES-50358 v1.02 disc and ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream Windows instructions to generate and build the game locally from source. The prereleases contain source only; the project explicitly says it is not playable.

warnings: Source-only prereleases; explicitly not playable; late-stream MPEG/rendering blockers.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
